'''Jabba's Game Plaza''' was an game venue on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. It was host to a gaming event organized by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].

==Overview==
{{Quote|You look as green as a monkey-lizard. Would you like me to show you how to play holochex?|Jabba the Hutt|<ref name="JGG" />}}
The gaming fair known as Jabba's Game Plaza was organized the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] as a new way to make [[Currency/Legends|money]]. The Game Plaza itself was located on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], in the vicinity of [[Wald's Parts|Watto's Shop]] and personal hangar. It consisted of four [[Tent/Legends|tents]] hosting gambling activities. The [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|racer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] hosted the game of [[Dueling Dice]], the [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]] played his own [[Ratts Race|mini race game]], the [[Veknoid/Legends|Veknoid]] [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]] played [[Digotto]], and Jabba himself participated in the event, acting as the gambler's opponent in the game of [[holochex]].<ref name="JGG" />

==History==
{{Quote|Now you better get on with it. And like I said, go to Jabba's and win some more credits. When you do, come back and see me.|Watto|<ref name="JGG" />}}
[[File:Watto_and_Zeppo_Marx.png|thumb|left|150px|Watto advises a spacer to enter Jabba's game competition.]]
Some time prior to the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline" /> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] participated in the gaming event of Jabba's Game Plaza in hopes of winning [[Wupiupi/Legends|Wupiupi credits]]. The stranger had been forced to stop on the [[Star/Legends|sun]]-scorched planet because of their damaged [[Starship/Legends|starship]], and they needed to buy replacement parts from the junk trader [[Watto/Legends|Watto]]. The deal required more money than the spacer could possibly afford. Eager to turn the stranger into a paying customer, Watto provided them with a map of Mos Espa and allowed them to use his [[Z-P70]] assistant [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Through participating in the games, the spacer finally won enough money to buy the parts and repair their ship, and they eventually flew off Tatooine.<ref name="JGG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jabba's Game Plaza was the setting of ''[[Star Wars Math: Jabba's Game Galaxy]]'', an educational video game released by [[Lucas Learning]] in [[2000]].
